question: Which male relatives are authorized to perform the food-eating rite?
premises: A paternal uncle, a brother, or a father is named as a possible performer.
The action enjoined is the performance of a rite.
The rite specified is the eating of food.
inference: A paternal uncle, brother, or father may perform the food-eating rite.
uncertainties: Whether pitṛ and bhrātā form a single compound meaning paternal uncle or are to be read separately is context-dependent.
plain_english: A paternal uncle, a brother, or even the father may perform the rite of eating food.
